purpose: A payment gateway that simplifies the complex process of handling card payments for merchants by providing a simple API for creating, capturing, refunding, and retrieving payments.

components.name: Payments Edge Gateway
components.evidence: All merchant traffic comes through it.

components.name: payments-core
components.evidence: The service with the payment rules and states.

components.name: Acquirer connector
components.evidence: the adapter that talks to the acquiring bank.

components.name: payment-events
components.evidence: a stream where we publish an event each time a payment changes status, so other teams can react.

flows.evidence: The merchant backend sends a payment request with a card token (not the card number). The edge gateway checks it and forwards the validated request to payments-core.
payments-core calls the acquirer through the connector.
